transaction_rule: candidate change -> compile -> validate -> isolated mount smoke -> review diff -> explicit publish -> drain/dispose previous container; candidate failure never changes active
publish_rule: publish is explicit and requires actor, base active hash, candidate hash, and required gates; stale base hash publish is rejected
rollback_rule: published runtime failure enters ErrorChain; automatic rollback to the previous plugin chain is forbidden
audit_rule: every install/enable/disable/configure/upgrade/publish/dispose is recorded in an immutable audit ledger without business payload
scope: Track B plugin management/admin surface: PluginManager, RuntimeInspector, Admin execute/query; consumes LifecyclePort only
